QUOTE: The asm path requires `MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM` plus a GNU-compatible compiler with extended asm (`constant_time_impl.h:39-52`). Otherwise `MBEDTLS_CT_ASM` stays undefined and the library uses C fallbacks
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the asm path needs MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM plus a compiler. It never says MBEDTLS_CT_ASM is derived rather than set in mbedtls_config.h, and it never mentions compiler predefined macros.
